verdict.note: Real spex eval lint in an isolated adopted project (tag library [cli]): each of missing-field, unknown-key, duplicate-name, ghost-code-path, dead selector, ambiguous selector and out-of-library tag produced exactly one eval-schema finding naming the scenario and its repair; the tag finding named both repairs and disappeared once lint.scenarioTags was extended; every scan exited 0. Dead and ambiguous are distinct diagnostics — a bare method name is dead because units carry lexical qualified names, and two top-level units sharing one name is what is ambiguous.
